name: research-workflow
description: Autonomously coordinate theoretical-physics research with on-demand tasks and evidence-based continuation.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous research with on-demand specialist tasks.
interface.longDescription: A research lead selects bounded tasks, interprets evidence and continues or redirects. Research, checks and advice are loaded on demand; internal records support chat-complete reporting.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use research-workflow:auto-research to advance this theoretical-physics research project.
